question: Simplify {256x⁴ - 16y⁴} over {(80x² - 20y²)}{(16x² + 4y²)}.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

**Formula used :** 

[(a + b)(a -b) = a2 - b2]

**Calculation:**

 {256x⁴ - 16y⁴} over {(80x² - 20y²)}{(16x² + 4y²)}

 {256x⁴ - 16y⁴} over {5(16x² - 4y²)}{(16x² + 4y²)} 

⇒ (256x4 - 16y4)/5 × (256x4 - 16y4)

⇒ 1/5

∴ The correct answer is 1/5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

 {256x⁴ - 16y⁴} over {(80x² - 20y²)}{(16x² + 4y²)}

⇒ (256x⁴ - 16y⁴)/(1280x⁴ + 320x²y² - 320x2y2 - 80y⁴)

⇒ (256x4 - 16y4)/(1280x4 - 80y4)

⇒ (256x4 - 16y4)/5 × (256x4 - 16y4)

⇒ 1/5

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.** [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==]
